display_long_description:
Welcome to the world of Extinct VR, an immersive single-player action-adventure and exploration VR experience that transports you to a bizarre realm filled with strange occurrences and challenging obstacles. In Extinct VR, you step into the shoes of an ordinary man thrust into extraordinary circumstances, navigating through a captivating universe where every corner hides new mysteries.
[media]
Encounter unique life forms reminiscent of cyborgs remnants of an advanced civilization that has faced its downfall. As you delve deeper into this enigmatic world, you’ll face a series of puzzles and formidable foes, each with their own tactics and weaknesses.
[media]
[media]
Experience the freedom of movement with both free locomotion and teleportation mechanics, allowing you to explore your surroundings and interact with the environment in unprecedented ways. Extinct VR also has a mode with a seated play feature.
[media]
Join us on this thrilling journey where courage, wit, and resourcefulness are your greatest allies. Will you uncover the secrets of Extinct VR and survive its many trials?
